Broadcom (AVGO) vs Coca Cola (KO): on the same formula, their operating margins are 11.2 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AVGO: $63.9B · KO: $47.9B
• Revenue growth — AVGO: +23.9% · KO: +1.9%
• Operating margin — AVGO: 39.9% · KO: 28.7%
• Net margin — AVGO: 36.2% · KO: 27.3%
• Free cash flow margin — AVGO: 42.1% · KO: 11.0%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AVGO: 23.5% · KO: 5.5%

Different fiscal years: AVGO Nov 2, 2025 · KO Dec 31, 2025. The periods are not identical.
